# C36 — Complexio Oppositorum

## #0

Complexio oppositorum names the indivisible relation within which opposed determinations can become distinct and consequential. [`0/1`](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) already holds One and All in this relation: source-unity and manifest-unity are different aspects of one whole. Their original inseparability precedes any later work of reconciling divided terms. A containing field becomes transformative when its achieved organisation can receive the difference its existing account could not bear.

## #1

The retained terms need real difference. Sym-ballein holds one and its own other through a seam that remains available for recognition. Signed polarity can also retain a common axis: opposition and conflict do not themselves mean war or total collapse. [Severance](C23-Severance.md) eliminates the relation; [fusion](C24-Fusion.md) eliminates the distinct terms. Original complexio gives differentiation its ground, while achieved complexio brings an encountered opposition back into a changed containing relation.

## #2

A [symbolic encounter](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) changes the interpreter and the world that can appear to that interpreter. The old categories can cease to suffice. Taylor's [Van Eenwyk encounter](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md) treats symbolic paradox as capable of reopening those categories through known→unknown→known, with the resulting organisation retaining a path back into life.

## #3

Hole and surface are inseparable in the torus’s genus-one form before circulation begins. The hole never becomes another surface-patch, yet closing it changes the form instead of completing that same form. `#0` carries the unobjectifiable opening and complete relation in originating phase; `#5` carries achieved surface and traversal in inverse phase. Their inseparability gives the original `0/1` complexio a topological image. Circulation performs that prior relation and returns its attained whole through the ground it could not count as another part. The exact [torus-cover operation](../../../symbolon/matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) separately relates a finite quotient to its infinite plane cover: a loop can close locally while its lift changes lattice address. An [atlas](../A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) relates nonidentical charts through transitions and obstructions. Each construction specifies how a local determination retains a relation it cannot exhaust; its hypotheses keep it answerable to its own mathematical object.

## #4

At the personal and ethical seam, common inclusion does not make the Other a possession of my model. [Selfing and subjectivity](C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing.md) preserve that asymmetry; [individuation](C34-Individuation.md) preserves a psychic centre's capacity to be reorganised while remaining this centre. In political application, a third can restore the common relation without choosing the average of opposed camps or suspending judgment about unequal power and responsibility. A container that merely hides the conflict under a claim to totality repeats the occupation of the source-office.

## #5→0

The return keeps the attained determinations while changing how they belong. [Paradox](C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) names the transforming event; individuation is a sustained lived process of such returns. The resulting whole is more capable of bearing difference because the terms and the account of their relation can both be revised. It is neither a final synthesis that owns its contents nor an endless oscillation with no changed capacity.

A psychic encounter changes the organisation through which opposed determinations can be borne; an atlas relates chart descriptions; a lifted torus loop retains a winding class. [Following the change in each](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD-homology-and-analogy.md#e5-whole-returns) makes their containing relations comparable without replacing their different objects or operations. Their common respect is a relation that sustains difference through a changed account. Neither the number of diagram positions nor a shared image establishes an identical mechanism. The achieved psychic capacity is the capacity to bear an opposition through a reorganised relation. Particular clinical effects require evidence of that lived change; chart transitions and winding classes alone do not establish it.
